lines.text: Peter asks Jesus how many times to forgive his brother, and Jesus answers seventy-seven times.
A king settling accounts has a servant who owes ten thousand talents brought in, and he orders the man sold.
The servant falls on his knees and begs, and his master forgives his debt out of compassion.
The forgiven servant chokes a fellow servant who owes him a hundred shekels and has him thrown into exile.
The other servants tell their neighbors, and the angry master hands the wicked servant to the jailers until he repays everything.
